title: FAA to finally ditch floppy disks in what it calls "historic" tech upgrade
summary: FAA information display systems to be floppy-free at 435 sites by end of 2028.
llm_summary: The Federal Aviation Administration is finally retiring the floppy‑disk drives that still power its air‑traffic information display systems, replacing them with modern solid‑state hardware at all 435 affected sites.
